nl.title: Cronjob instellen in DirectAdmin
nl.excerpt: Plan een cronjob in DirectAdmin (tijd + commando) voor onderhoudsscripts.
nl.bodyHtml:
Cron runt commando’s op schema (backupscripts, WP-cron alternatief, imports).

Voorbereiding

  • Juiste commando/pad
  • Begrip van tijdvelden

Stappen

  1. Advanced Features → Cron Jobs
  2. Create Cron Job
  3. Stel minute/hour/day/month/weekday in
  4. Vul commando in (volledig pad naar php/curl)
  5. Sla op en check e-mailoutput indien ingesteld

Controleren

  • Job verschijnt in de lijst
  • Output/log toont succes

Tip: Test het commando eerst handmatig via SSH als je die hebt.

Let op: Te frequente crons kunnen CPU/IO opjagen.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

en.title: Set up Cronjob in DirectAdmin
en.excerpt: Step-by-step guide: Set up Cronjob in DirectAdmin via DirectAdmin at TripleZero iT.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide helps you complete Set up Cronjob in DirectAdmin safely and in a verifiable way at TripleZero iT.

We use DirectAdmin. Always work on the correct domain/account and take a backup first when the change is risky.

What you need

  • Access to DirectAdmin.
  • Your domain name and any login credentials.
  • A recent backup before structural or risky changes.

Steps

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin and select the correct domain or user account.
  2. Open the relevant module (Account Manager, Email Accounts, DNS Management, File Manager, Installatron, SSL Certificates or Advanced Features).
  3. Note the current value or status before you change anything.
  4. Apply the change, save, and stay on this domain.
  5. Test outside the panel (browser, webmail or external DNS lookup).

Verify

  • Expected behaviour is visible outside the panel.
  • No new errors in logs or monitoring.
  • Backup or rollback path is still available.

Tip: Note old values before you save. That makes rollback faster.

Note: Do not change multiple critical options at once on production.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Also browse other knowledge-base articles on hosting, email and security.
